source.note: Official GPX and 2026 race-book checkpoints and cut-offs. The 2027 route may change slightly.

aidStations.name: Ospitale
aidStations.legNote: Cortina streets and crowds, the first night climb (Night Ridge), then forest trails and the old railway line to Ospitale. Classic fast-start trap: the first hour should feel too easy.

aidStations.name: Passo Tre Croci
aidStations.legNote: Long night climb above 2,100 m, then down to Passo Tre Croci. First cut-off at Sat 04:30.

aidStations.name: Federavecchia
aidStations.legNote: Fast descent in the dark on roots and loose gravel.

aidStations.name: Misurina
aidStations.legNote: Climb to Lago di Misurina. Cut-off Sat 08:00.

aidStations.name: Rifugio Auronzo
aidStations.legNote: Tre Cime climb to Rifugio Auronzo with sunrise over the Tre Cime di Lavaredo.

aidStations.name: Forcella Lavaredo
aidStations.legNote: Rocky final ramp to Forcella Lavaredo, the high point of the race at about 2,450 m.

aidStations.name: Cimabanche
aidStations.legNote: Long descent through Val Rinbon to Landro, then a gentle valley climb to the Cimabanche life base (drop bag, crew allowed).

aidStations.name: Malga Ra Stua
aidStations.legNote: Climb to Forcella Lerosa, then down to Malga Ra Stua. Often hot around midday.

aidStations.name: Malga Travenanzes
aidStations.legNote: Down to Pian de Loa, then the long remote climb up Val Travenanzes with stream crossings and few bail-out points.

aidStations.name: Rifugio Col Gallina
aidStations.legNote: Over Forcella Col dei Bos and down to Rifugio Col Gallina (hot food, crew allowed).

aidStations.name: Rifugio Averau
aidStations.legNote: Short brutal climb to Rifugio Averau below Nuvolau, the steepest gym of the race.

aidStations.name: Passo Giau
aidStations.legNote: Traverse and descent to Passo Giau. Cut-off Sat 23:59.

aidStations.name: Rifugio Croda da Lago
aidStations.legNote: Forcella Giau and Forcella Ambrizzola, the last climbs, then down to Rifugio Croda da Lago.

aidStations.name: Cortina d'Ampezzo
aidStations.legNote: Final forest descent into Cortina on tired quads.
